topic: Set-off and carry forward of business losses
question: Explain the provisions of the Income-tax Act, 1961 on set-off and carry forward of losses from business, including speculation business.

points.label: Set-off in the same year
points.description: A loss from a non-speculation business can be set off against income from another business in the same year and, if any remains, against income under other heads.

points.label: Not against salary
points.description: Business loss cannot be set off against income under the head 'Salaries'.

points.label: Carry forward of non-speculation loss
points.description: Loss not set off can be carried forward for eight assessment years and set off only against business or profession income; the business need not be continuing.

points.label: Speculation loss
points.description: Loss from a speculation business can be set off only against speculation income, and can be carried forward for four assessment years.

points.label: Return filed in time; depreciation
points.description: A business loss can be carried forward only if the loss return is filed by the due date under section 139(1); unabsorbed depreciation is not subject to this and can be carried forward without time limit.
